_README: POETRY — A STUB, DOGEARED. The owner set this page aside on 2026-10-31 and
returns to it later. The array below stays empty on purpose, and the page
renders the waiting line instead of a layout built against invented verse.
NOTHING REACHES THIS FILE AUTOMATICALLY. 89 pieces sit split and gitignored
under poetry-source/, each awaiting a metadata block the owner fills in.
Only a piece marked would_publish: yes crosses over, and the owner moves it
himself. Read projects/poetry/README.md before touching any of it, and read
CLAUDE.md on why poetry-source/ never enters git: those files hold dated
journal entries, named people and private reflection in the same pages as
title   the piece's own title, as the owner titles it.
text    the verse itself. Line breaks survive verbatim — the page sets
white-space: pre-line and left-aligns inside a centered block.
credit  optional. A date, a place, a note.
Every piece gets its own full bay with generous margin, and a four-line
piece carries the same typographic authority as a sixty-line one. Report C
section 4 works that out in full; the rules already sit in assets/site.css.
waiting: The verse waits on its author. He knows where it lives.
